description_en: Lists the uploaded image versions in an image repository
description_zh: 调用ListAcrImageTags查看镜像仓库中已上传的镜像版本
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-acr-image-tags --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAW8kZY+u1sYOaYf5JmgmDQQ= --repo-id crr-3gqhkza0wbxxxxxx --artifact-type AcrImage --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAcrImageTags

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.
parameters.description_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20

parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description_en: The token for the next page of results.

parameters.name: next_token

parameters.description_en: The ID of the image repository.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the image repository
parameters.name: repo_id
